findings.note: Oct. 2, 2026 RotoWire note: Luostarinen scored two goals, one on the power play, in a 4-3 OT loss to San Jose. It said he was on the third line but could get power-play time if Barkov's leg injury proved serious. Barkov's current status was not found.

Player page with RotoWire notes saying he was slated for the third line in 2026-27 and would likely return to a defensive middle-six role. He has topped 40 points only once. He had 33 points in 73 games last season, under one point per game.

Training-camp article saying he opened the season on a line with Anton Lundell. Coach Paul Maurice said he won't give up the hard defensive parts of the game to score more points. No injury, lineup or analyst pick for the Oct. 30 game against Winnipeg was found.
